items.title: Lloyd’s of London creates unified oversight function under efficiency drive
items.summary: Lloyd’s of London is combining governance, performance, reserving and capital setting into a single oversight function led by Rachel Turk.

items.title: TPR finds formal governance lacking across small DC pension schemes
items.summary: The Pensions Regulator has reported that only 27% of small defined contribution schemes maintain formal governance arrangements.

items.title: UK core dividend payouts rise 13.2% in Q3
items.summary: Capital Group's latest Dividend Watch reports growth in UK company dividends during the third quarter of 2026.

items.title: Investor sentiment on UK economy drops in October
items.summary: A survey by Boring Money indicates a sharp decline in investor confidence regarding the UK economy in October 2026.

items.title: Delcam pension scheme secures £28m buy-in with Royal London
items.summary: The Delcam Retirement Benefits Scheme has completed a £28m bulk purchase annuity transaction with Royal London to secure benefits for 171 members.

items.title: Lloyd’s restructures operating model to cut complexity and cost
items.summary: Lloyd’s of London is reorganising its oversight and operational structure to reduce friction and costs.
